roster.name: Access to Biological Collection Data (ABCD) Schema
roster.description: A comprehensive TDWG technical specification (XML schema) for exchanging primary biodiversity data about specimens and observations (DataSet, Unit, Identification, Gathering, Multimedia, etc.); includes ratified 2.06 and later 3.0 XML versions and application schemas.

roster.name: ABCD 3.0 Ontology (ABCD OWL)
roster.description: An OWL ontology representation of the ABCD model for expressing collection data as RDF/Linked Data: defines classes, object and datatype properties, controlled-vocabulary individuals and metaproperties for ABCD concepts.

roster.name: ABCD Extension for Geosciences (EFG / ABCDEFG)
roster.description: An extension schema to ABCD that adds terms for geoscience collection items (paleontology, mineralogy, rocks, stratigraphy, analyses); provided as an XSD and documented as a TDWG extension under ratification.
